# Vulkan Headers

Unmodified build-time subset of KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers, tag `v1.4.341`, tag object `0d3f509e57041fbd073a1ee84cd9ccd36d148446`.

Source: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers/tree/v1.4.341

Includes the C core/loader headers and their video header dependencies. No Vulkan loader, driver, validation layer, SDK installer or runtime is bundled. See `LICENSE.md`, `LICENSES/Apache-2.0.txt`, `LICENSES/MIT.txt` and each file's SPDX/copyright notice.

Thank you to The Khronos Group, Valve, LunarG and all Vulkan-Headers contributors for the open API and loader interfaces used to build and verify this integration.
